name: Close-Stance Hack Squat
steps: Step into a hack squat machine with your shoulders under the pads and back flat against the sled.
Place your feet close together on the platform, push up to unlock the safeties, and brace your core.
Bend your hips and knees to lower the carriage as far as you can keep your heels planted and your pelvis on the pad.
Drive through both feet to stand without snapping your knees, then lock the safeties before exiting.
tips: Choose a foot position that lets your heels and lower back stay supported throughout.
Keep your knees aligned with your toes rather than letting them cave inward.
